# A file head is generated by Format-FileMeta and never edited by hand

## Eyebrow

5 / 14 · fact · ADR-REPO-FILEMETA

## Lead

Facts are never read from heads; a head carries only what its policy allows, required or optional or forbidden, and the edges the file cites.
